description: This file contains utility functions for verifying the URL resolution for the '/api/users' endpoint within a frontend codebase, including support for organization-specific query parameters. It includes functions for constructing, logging, and testing the URL, primarily used during development or debugging.

methods.name: verifyUsersUrlResolution(organizationIdOverride = null)
methods.description: Constructs and logs the expected URL for the '/api/users' endpoint with optional organization ID override, verifying correctness during development.

methods.name: quickUsersResolutionSmoke()
methods.description: A helper function that calls verifyUsersUrlResolution with a sample organization ID ('T0015') for testing purposes without mutating state.
